finding: An isolated SQLite trigger/occurrence ledger supports idempotent registration, generation-based disable, explicit missed-window policy, single due-slot claim, immutable terminal outcomes, unresolved-claim inspection and stable AZ-025 action keys. Eight deterministic tests and a separate-process restart fixture pass. A bounded verified-scope host reminder source now claims due intervals and posts local inbox notices (never model or external actions); its clock-jump/duplicate/disable and concurrent-poll deduplication fixtures pass 2/2, as do two frontend-client tests, frontend typecheck and production build. WorkZ exposes hour/day/week controls for repository tasks, and the title bar polls while the project is open. Full task automation, actual OS sleep/resume and native product acceptance are incomplete.
conclusion_proposal: Keep pending until a controlled task execution adapter, AZ-025 permits for external actions, actual sleep/resume and native product acceptance are integrated.
next_action: Extend the verified-scope reminder source to controlled task execution with AZ-025 permits and budgets; exercise real sleep/resume and native disable/click journeys.
remaining_work: AZ-025 permit binding for external actions
verification_gaps: Only local reminder dispatch, no automated task execution
No actual OS sleep/resume or native journey test
